entry.name: jit.gl.meshwarp
entry.description: The jit.gl.meshwarp object deforms visual material projected on a two-dimensional mesh. It can be used for video-mapping or other creative applications.

arguments.name: drawto
arguments.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none). A named drawing context is a named instance of a,orobject. If no argument is provided the object will find a context implicitly.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: apply_mask
attributes.digest: Hide or show meshwarp plane using existing masks.
attributes.description: Hide or show meshwarp plane using existing masks (default = 0)

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: The color of the mesh (default = 1. 1. 1. 1.)

attributes.name: curvature
attributes.digest: Set both the X and Y NURBS order.
attributes.description: A quick way to set both the X and Y NURBS order, which determines the curvature of the underlying canvas mesh (range 0. to 1.) Sets both dims of, based on the current. The attribute is float type, however output is clamped to int values and therefore may look choppy when adjusting.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Enable flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, drawing is enabled.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: grid_color
attributes.digest: Set the color of the UI mesh grid (default = random);
attributes.description: Set the color of the UI mesh grid (default = random);

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: invert_mask
attributes.digest: Invert mask (default = 0)
attributes.description: When the flag is set, the mask is inverted. Only what is contained inside the masks will be shown in the meshwarp plane.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: layer
attributes.digest: Object layer number (default = 0)
attributes.description: Object layer number (default = 0). When in automatic mode, the layer number determines the rendering order (low to high). Objects in the same layer have no guarantee which will be rendered first.

attributes.name: lock_to_aspect
attributes.digest: Lock scale to input texture ratio flag (default = 0)
attributes.description: Locks the scale to match the proportions of the input texture (default = 0). When set to active, the scale attribute will only respond to the second attribute argument (y scale).

attributes.name: mask_mode
attributes.digest: Enable masking mode (default = 0)
attributes.description: When the flag is set, masking mode is enabled and the following editing operations are supported:

attributes.name: meshdim
attributes.digest: Dimension of UI mesh (default = 4 4)
attributes.description: Dimension of the UI mesh. Sets the number of clickable vertices displayed (default = 4 4)

attributes.name: nurbs_order
attributes.digest: Set the X and Y order of the NURBS canvas mesh (default = 1 1).
attributes.description: Set the X and Y order of the underlying NURBS canvas mesh. The order determines the curvature of the canvas mesh (default = 1 1).

attributes.name: output_texture
attributes.digest: Capture to internal texture
attributes.description: Capture to internal texture (default = 0). When enabled, the rendering of this meshwarp is captured to texture and the texture name is output out the left outlet. The dimensions of the texture are equal to the dimensions of the rendering window.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: The 3D origin in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.)
attributes.description: The 3D origin in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.)

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rotatez
attributes.digest: Sets the current rotation in degrees.
attributes.description: Sets the current rotation about the positive z axes (default = 0.). Angles are expressed in degrees.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.digest: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1. 1. 1.)
attributes.description: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1. 1. 1.)

attributes.name: show_position_handle
attributes.digest: Show / Hide position handle circle flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Show / Hide position handle circle flag (default = 1)

attributes.name: show_scale_handles
attributes.digest: Show / Hide scale handle circles flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Show / Hide scale handle circles flag (default = 1)

attributes.name: show_ui
attributes.digest: Show / Hide user interface flag (default = 1)
attributes.description: Show or hide the interactive user interface for the jit.gl.meshwarp (default = 1). When the flag is set, the object will be highlighted if not currently selected.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: texture
attributes.digest: The name of the texture to be applied (default = none)
attributes.description: The name of the texture to be applied (default = none).

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: jit_gl_texture
messages.description: Binds the texture specified by texture-name to this object. Equivalent to setting the texture attribute to texture-name.

messages.name: mesh_matrix
messages.digest: Set meshwarp vertex data with a matrix
messages.description: The vertex data for the meshwarp can be set with a matrix. The matrix must be two dimensional and have two planes for the X and Y vertex coordinates.

messages.name: output_mesh_matrix
messages.description: Outputs the meshwarp vertex data as a matrix.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read the complete current state of the jit.gl.meshwarp object from a JSON file (.json).
messages.description: Read the complete current state of the jit.gl.meshwarp object from a JSON file (.json). If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file.

messages.name: redo
messages.description: Redo latest undone UI changes. Can be also called by pressing "ctrl + y/cmd + shift + z" on the keyboard.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Reset the jit.gl.meshwarp to the default state
messages.description: Reset the jit.gl.meshwarp to the default state. It will reset the scale, position, rotation and color attributes.

messages.name: save
messages.digest: Save the complete current state of the jit.gl.meshwarp object to a JSON file (.json).
messages.description: Save the complete current state of the jit.gl.meshwarp object to a JSON file (.json). If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file.

messages.name: undo
messages.description: Undo latest UI changes. Can be also called by pressing "ctrl/cmd + z" on the keyboard.
